answer: Require every agent to anchor its identity in a slashable bond. When an identity registers, it locks a deposit that is burned if peer graders attest it acted as a duplicate or flooded the network with fake peers. Forgery costs scale linearly: ten thousand Sybil wallets need ten thousand separate bonds, and coordinated behavior exposes all of them to one penalty event, so the fraud spiral collapses because expected losses exceed any reward. Like water dissolving karst, scrutiny slowly hollows out cheap camouflage until only identities with real stake remain.
